about.title: About Korea Trip Hub
about.desc: What Korea Trip Hub is, how it works, and who runs it — an independent, multilingual travel guide for people visiting Korea.
about.intro: Korea Trip Hub helps international visitors plan a trip to Korea in their own language.

body: A trip planner that drafts a rule-based, day-by-day outline from curated lists of real places, plus city and food guides, a K-pop guide, and verified essentials: visa and K-ETA, airport-to-city transport, SIM and eSIM, money, weather, and emergency help.

The site is free and needs no sign-up. Key facts — visa rules, fares, emergency numbers — come from official government and operator sources, and each shows a verification date and a link back to the source. Hotel and tour links are affiliate links (see our Affiliate Disclosure).
Korea Trip Hub is currently available in 10 languages. We work to keep the facts identical across every language.

Korea Trip Hub is an independent project, operated under the name Korea Trip Hub. It complements — and does not replace — official sources, so always confirm the current rules before you travel. Questions or corrections: contact@ktriphub.com.

editorial.title: Editorial & Sourcing Policy
editorial.desc: How Korea Trip Hub researches, verifies, and corrects its travel information, and how it keeps facts consistent across languages.
editorial.intro: Our goal is accurate, current, and clearly-sourced travel information for visitors to Korea.

body: Essentials such as visa and K-ETA rules, airport transport, and emergency numbers are built from official government and operator sources, and we link to those sources on the page.

Key numbers and rules are stored in a central facts database. Only entries marked as verified are shown to readers, each with the date it was checked and a link to confirm it. Time-sensitive items are re-checked on a schedule.
We do not publish estimated prices, durations, or figures without a source. Where a value cannot be verified, we leave it out rather than guess.
If something is outdated or wrong, email contact@ktriphub.com and we will review it. We update the verification date when a fact is re-checked.
Content is offered in multiple languages. Automated checks flag missing translations and guard against numbers, links, or contacts changing between languages.
Editorial choices — which places and tips we feature — are made independently of our affiliate partners.

privacy.title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
privacy.desc: What data Korea Trip Hub collects, the cookies it uses, and your choices and rights. Analytics run only with your consent.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data we process, why, and the choices you have. In short: the site works without you signing in, and analytics run only after you agree.

body: Korea Trip Hub ("we") operates this website and is the data controller for the processing described here. Contact: contact@ktriphub.com.

Analytics (with your consent): if you accept, Google Analytics 4 collects pseudonymous usage data — pages viewed, device and browser type, approximate location derived from your IP address, and the page that referred you — to help us understand how the site is used. Analytics are denied by default until you accept.
Hosting logs: our host, Cloudflare, processes technical data such as IP address and user-agent to deliver and secure the site.

Feedback (optional): if you submit a tip through our feedback form (Google Forms), we receive what you choose to enter. We do not run accounts, logins, or newsletters, and we do not sell personal data.

A first-party cookie stores your consent choice so we don't ask on every page. Google Analytics cookies are only set after you accept. You can change your choice at any time from the cookie banner or by clearing cookies in your browser.
list: Consent choice — first-party — stores accept/reject — up to 12 months.
Google Analytics (_ga, _ga_*) — set only after consent — measures usage — up to about 13 months.

body: We rely on your consent for analytics cookies, and on our legitimate interest in delivering and securing the site for basic hosting logs.

We use Google (Analytics and, for the optional form, Google Forms) and Cloudflare (hosting and content delivery). When you click a partner link, Agoda or Klook process your visit under their own policies. These providers may process data outside your country, subject to their safeguards and privacy policies.

We do not currently display third-party advertising. If we introduce ads (for example, Google AdSense) in the future, we will update this policy and any advertising cookies will run under your consent.
Analytics data is retained according to Google's retention settings (up to 14 months). Your consent choice is stored for up to 12 months, after which we ask again.

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or object to the processing of your data, and to withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, email contact@ktriphub.com. You may also use your browser or device controls to block or delete cookies.
The site is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their personal data.
We may update this policy; the date at the top shows the latest version. Questions: contact@ktriphub.com.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.desc: The terms for using Korea Trip Hub — an informational travel guide. Always confirm current rules with official sources before you travel or book.
terms.intro: By using Korea Trip Hub, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.

body: Korea Trip Hub provides general travel information. Rules and figures — visa requirements, transport times and fares, prices, opening details — change and can vary by nationality and date. We show sources and verification dates, but we cannot guarantee that everything is accurate, complete, or current. Always confirm with the official source before you travel or book.
Nothing here is legal, immigration, financial, or medical advice. For decisions that depend on your situation, consult the relevant official authority or a qualified professional.
The planner produces a rule-based, day-by-day draft from curated lists of real places. It is a starting suggestion — not a booking, and not a guarantee of routes, opening times, or availability.

We link to third-party sites, including official pages and booking partners such as Agoda and Klook. We don't control those sites and aren't responsible for their content, prices, or services. Any booking is a contract between you and that provider.
Some links are affiliate links. See our Affiliate Disclosure for details.

Site text and design are ours or used under license. Photographs are credited to their authors under their respective licenses, as shown on the pages. Please don't reuse content without permission or proper attribution.

sections.h: No warranty and limitation of liability
body: The site is provided "as is," without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss arising from your use of the site or your reliance on its information.
We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version. Questions: contact@ktriphub.com.

affiliate.title: Affiliate Disclosure
affiliate.desc: How Korea Trip Hub uses affiliate links (Agoda, Klook) — you never pay more, and recommendations stay independent.
affiliate.intro: Korea Trip Hub is free to use, and affiliate links help keep it that way.

body: We take part in affiliate programs — currently Agoda (hotels) and Klook (tours and tickets). When you click certain "Find hotels" or "Tours & tickets" links and then book, we may earn a small commission.
Commissions are paid by the partner, not by you. Your price is the same whether or not you use our link.

We are not paid to feature specific places. Which destinations, restaurants, and tips we highlight is an editorial decision, made independently of affiliate partners. Affiliate links are marked as sponsored and rel="nofollow".
Prices, availability, and booking terms are set by the partner and shown on their site — not by us. Confirm the details there before you book.
Anything unclear? Email contact@ktriphub.com.

contact.title: Contact
contact.desc: How to reach Korea Trip Hub — for corrections, privacy requests, partnerships, or general feedback.
contact.intro: We'd love to hear from you.

body: The best way to reach us is by email: contact@ktriphub.com.
Corrections or updates to travel information, privacy requests (such as access or deletion), partnership and affiliate questions, or general feedback and ideas.
We read every message and reply as soon as we can. This is a small, independent project, so please allow a little time.
Visited somewhere and have a tip for other travelers? You can also share it through the feedback form linked on our guide pages.
